title: Origin story: Hollowmere
description: Hollowmere is the spirit of a lake that dried up centuries ago, leaving a hollow of white clay. She is the guardian of empty places — the cleared field, the abandoned house, the silence after the song. She teaches that emptiness is not nothing: it is room for what comes next.

title: Ability profile: Hollowmere
description: Ranked abilities: Emptiness — rank 100/100; Patience — rank 99/100; Calm — rank 98/100; Shelter — rank 95/100; Teaching — rank 94/100.

title: Power ranking: Hollowmere
description: Powers: Empty places obey her; She makes room — for growth, for grief, for rest; The hollow holds what the full cannot.

title: Stamina feats: Hollowmere
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Waited centuries in the dry hollow; Guarded without rest.

title: Crossover notes: Hollowmere
